definitions.explanation: a medical condition caused by the body overheating due to prolonged exposure to high temperatures or physical exertion in hot weather

examples.japanese: {熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}に{気|き}をつけて。
{夏|なつ}は{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}で{倒|たお}れる{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people collapse from heatstroke in summer.

examples.japanese: {熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}を{予防|よぼう}するには、こまめに{水分|すいぶん}を{取|と}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: To prevent heatstroke, it's important to drink water frequently.

notes:
FORMATION:
{熱中|ねっちゅう} (being absorbed in) + {症|しょう} (illness, condition) → heat-related illness

Note: The {熱中|ねっちゅう} in {熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう} refers to {熱|ねつ} (heat) + {中|ちゅう} (middle/during), not the verb {熱中|ねっちゅう}する (to be absorbed in).

SYMPTOMS ({症状|しょうじょう}):
- めまい (dizziness)
- {頭痛|ずつう} (headache)
- {吐|は}き{気|け} (nausea)
- {意識|いしき}{障害|しょうがい} (loss of consciousness)

PREVENTION ({予防|よぼう}):
- {水分補給|すいぶんほきゅう} (staying hydrated)
- {塩分|えんぶん}{補給|ほきゅう} (salt intake)
- {日陰|ひかげ}で{休|やす}む (rest in the shade)
- エアコンを{使|つか}う (use air conditioning)

WARNING INDEX:
{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}{警戒|けいかい}アラート (heatstroke warning alert) is issued by the Japan Meteorological Agency during extreme heat.
